pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the terrifying daylight landing of a glowing UFO in Voronezh, but when investigators tested the soil, the reality turned pitch black. Soviet scientists rushed to the landing site, discovering unusually high concentrations of radioactive isotopes and strange mineral traces completely unknown to Earth geology. Stranger still, compasses spun wildly out of control across the entire park for days afterward, confirming a massive electromagnetic disturbance. Official state documents later corroborated that multiple police officers and local adults had witnessed the exact same humanoid entities walking through the park. To this day, mainstream science has zero rational explanations for the physical traces left behind. The Voronezh landing remains one of the most thoroughly documented close encounters in human history.
